rule: Trust roots must exist in the Work Order base commit. Mission branches may consume but never create or broaden their own trust.

PROJECT_EXTERNAL_REVIEW.note: Template: add reviewer/integrator PUBLIC keys on canonical main before mission dispatch. Keep private seeds outside the repository.

custody_rule: Every key used for MEDIUM+ review/integration declares custody_id and custody_class. Review and integration must use distinct external custody domains. This is structural evidence; a local-only repository still cannot prove physical key custody.
